text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Gasp...!!!! I'm so deeply moved, 
sir/ma'am!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A carpet of cherry blossom petals spanning 
all the way from the dorms to the 
academy!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It was truly a birthday triumph befitting 
the new Class Rep!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it is an auspicious breeze. And the 
gorgeous swirl of cherry blossom petals 
stirred up by it was truly a feast for the 
eyes, was it not?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Whenever Bakushin O-san ran, petals 
went fluttering everywhere. It was so 
beautiful!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Still, where on earth did all those petals 
come from? Cherry blossom season is 
practically over by now.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Zephyr got permission for us, so we 
went to collect them in the mountains!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I happened to know of a place where 
double-flowered cherry blossoms grow in 
clusters. When celebrating Bakushin O-san, 
cherry blossoms are simply a must.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! When you think of me, you think of 
cherry blossoms! And vice versa! What 
wonderful thoughtfulness from both of 
you!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"If that's the case, I can't just stand 
here! Time for another Bakshin—no, double 
Bakshin—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Argh, no matter how many Bakushins it 
takes until my strength runs out!! Let us 
dash down the runway with all our might!!

text_block_list.name: Flower & Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, please have fun!\nHehe, I hope you 
enjoy it."
